confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the more reliable, since local price levels for Crete are relatively well known. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain because bar pricing in Chania's old town and harbour varies widely. Accommodation anchors are the least certain: they depend on season, booking lead time and venue type, and July is peak season, so the values are bounded estimates for that window. The FX rate is the RBA observation for 2026-10-16 and is not used to set the anchors; the anchors are in USD as the model's own estimate of July 2026 prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated from general knowledge of mid-sized Cretan and other Greek island tourist towns with similar summer demand and taverna-style dining, cross-checked against typical Southern European coastal tourist-town price levels. No specific Chania venue or listing was consulted.
